tasks.short: Plan and implement habitat, soil and water conservation projects.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual site maps, habitat evidence, soil/water records and conservation requirements
inputs: actual conservation project/site
actual geospatial, ecological and soil/water source records
outputs: checked actual conservation site context

steps.what: Survey actual habitat, soil and water conditions and capture new field observations
inputs: checked actual conservation site context
actual site and field measurement methods
outputs: actual captured ecological and soil/water observations

steps.what: Choose actual wildlife habitat and soil/water conservation objectives, interventions and implementation conditions
inputs: actual captured ecological and soil/water observations
checked actual conservation site context
actual landowner and implementation constraints
outputs: actual chosen conservation project decisions

steps.what: Record and check final conservation project plan using actual site and chosen intervention fields
inputs: actual chosen conservation project decisions
actual captured ecological and soil/water observations
outputs: checked final conservation plan and permitted implementation recipients

steps.what: Save checked final conservation project plan
inputs: checked final conservation plan and permitted implementation recipients
outputs: saved actual conservation project plan

steps.what: Deliver exact checked conservation project plan to actual authorised implementation partners
inputs: checked final conservation plan and permitted implementation recipients
outputs: actual conservation implementation plan delivered

steps.what: Implement actual approved conservation interventions and check actual field work
inputs: actual authorised conservation project plan
actual site, materials and implementation conditions
outputs: actual implemented conservation work and observed results

tasks.design: Configure native site/geospatial links in {DATA_PLATFORM} and repeated plan fields in {PROJECT} and {DOCS}. Retain all field survey, ecological decisions and implementation; the final plan is checked before separate save and partner delivery through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Conservation planning can repeat site-source navigation and stable site fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native site and project links can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: Effective habitat and soil/water measures depend on actual ecological conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The forester recognises a site-specific intervention that would harm another conservation objective.
tasks.altitude: Less planning administration; conservation judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native geospatial/project links and plan fields can assist conservation administration; they do not survey a site or implement conservation measures.

assumptions: Actual map/ecological/landowner sources supply existing records; forester verifies scope and produces new field observations in retained s2. Actual intervention choices and all primary measurement remain retained.

S4 reduces repeated identifiers/location fields only; new plan meaning and complete checks remain. Actual partner delivery only where required; authority/permissions must actually exist before s7, not inferred from plan delivery. Any actual completion record/changed field instruction needs its own final-version checked action; no avoided labour claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native links/fields first; existing functions earn zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing checks. Shared site evidence counted once; partner labour excluded.
unknowns: Which site fields and source navigation repeat?
research_questions: Can native links reduce administration after full field and plan checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual site/source links and conservation plan fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final conservation plan and exact project destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact final conservation plan and authorised implementation recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 14*0.40 lookup + 10*0.20 repeated fields = 7.6; minus 1 upkeep = 6.6. Half eligible gives 3.8 minus 1 = 2.8. Actual survey, decisions, final checks, save/send and implementation retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual cleared-land reclamation plans, maps and previous monitoring evidence
inputs: actual cleared site and approved end-use objectives
actual geospatial and prior monitoring records
outputs: checked actual reclamation context

steps.what: Monitor actual forest-cleared lands and assess reclamation against suitable end-use objectives
inputs: checked actual reclamation context
actual land condition and field observations
outputs: actual captured reclamation observations and chosen assessment

steps.what: Record and check final actual reclamation findings using native site and visit fields
inputs: actual captured reclamation observations and chosen assessment
checked actual reclamation context
outputs: checked final actual reclamation monitoring record

steps.what: Commit checked actual cleared-land reclamation monitoring record
inputs: checked final actual reclamation monitoring record
outputs: saved actual reclamation findings

tasks.design: Configure native site/plan links and repeated visit fields in the geospatial module of {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}. Retain actual land monitoring and suitability assessment, with new findings capture/check before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reclamation visits can repeat source navigation and stable site entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native site/visit links can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: End-use suitability requires actual ecological and land-condition evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The forester recognises apparently green land whose soil or habitat condition remains unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Less monitoring administration; field assessment stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native site/visit fields can support reclamation records; they do not establish suitable end use from a map alone.

assumptions: Actual site/plan owners produce existing evidence; forester checks sources and produces actual new observations/assessment in s2. No field condition is inferred from a planned reclamation action.

S3 reduces repeated site identifiers/headings only; new findings and complete scientific/source checks remain. Actual record branch only where required. Any actual remediation instruction/report delivery requires its own final-version checked action; no avoided labour claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native functions first; existing views/prefill earn zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing final checking. Shared conservation evidence counted once.
unknowns: Which source navigation and site fields repeat?
research_questions: Can native fields reduce entry after complete observation and suitability checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual reclamation site/plan links and visit fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual reclamation findings and exact site/visit destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 lookup + 14*0.20 repeated fields = 8.8; minus 1 upkeep = 7.8. Half eligible gives 4.4 minus 1 = 3.4. Actual monitoring, judgement, new capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct and participate in actual forest fire suppression.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual fire maps, access information and current incident context
inputs: actual current incident and location
actual incident-owner updates and geospatial access records
outputs: checked current incident context and information gaps

steps.what: Choose and check actual suppression instructions against live conditions and command authority
inputs: checked current incident context and information gaps
actual observed fire, crew, weather and terrain conditions
outputs: checked final actual suppression instructions and intended crew recipients

steps.what: Communicate exact checked suppression instructions to actual intended crews
inputs: checked final actual suppression instructions and intended crew recipients
continuing actual incident conditions
outputs: actual suppression instructions communicated and understood

steps.what: Direct live operations and physically participate in actual forest fire suppression
inputs: actual fire and crew activity
actual understood suppression instructions and changing conditions
outputs: actual suppression actions, observed conditions and outcomes

steps.what: Record and check actual suppression actions and outcomes where incident log is required
inputs: actual suppression actions, observed conditions and outcomes
outputs: checked final actual suppression log entry

steps.what: Save checked actual forest fire suppression log entry
inputs: checked final actual suppression log entry
outputs: saved actual suppression log

tasks.design: Configure native incident/map links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DATA_PLATFORM} only for repeated source navigation. Retain live command decisions, separately checked instruction communication through {TELEPHONY}, actual suppression and required outcome capture/check before a separate log save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Incident preparation can repeat map/access-source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native incident/map links can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Fire behaviour, crew safety and actual suppression require live competent judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The forester responds immediately when changing conditions invalidate the current instruction.
tasks.altitude: Less map lookup; live fire work stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native incident/map links can reduce source navigation; they do not determine fire tactics or suppress a fire.

assumptions: Actual incident owners supply timestamped updates and maps; forester verifies freshness/gaps in s1. All actual weather/fire/crew observations, tactic choices and physical work remain retained. Missing information requires actual verification, not a guessed safe route.

S2/s3 repeat for each actual instruction after its final content exists; changed conditions void the check. S4 does not hide new orders: each new order returns through s2/s3. No additional approval ceremony or command authority is introduced.

Actual log only if required and owned by this forester; otherwise remove/reweight. Shares are provisional, not measured. Native views first; existing map access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing checking; no physical or crew-time saving.
unknowns: Is any actual map/access navigation repeated beyond existing incident tools?
research_questions: Can native links reduce lookup without delaying live checks or communication?

incremental.description: Maintain actual incident/map links and freshness checks.

approvals.approved_version: s2 exact final suppression instruction and actual crew recipients while conditions remain current; changes require recheck
s5 checked final actual actions/outcomes entry and exact incident-log destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 map/source navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. All command decisions, communication, physical suppression and actual log capture/check/save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study tree species, environmental requirements and disease/insect resistance.

steps.what: Find and verify actual tree-species classification, ecology and disease/insect research sources
inputs: actual species/research question
actual botanical, ecological and experimental sources
outputs: checked relevant actual tree-species sources

steps.what: Study species' classification, life history, light/soil needs, adaptation and disease/insect resistance
inputs: checked relevant actual tree-species sources
actual source methods, observations and uncertainties
outputs: actual interpreted species evidence and unanswered questions

steps.what: Observe actual tree specimens and sites or conduct actual required species-study measurements
inputs: actual interpreted species evidence and unanswered questions
actual trees/sites and study methods
outputs: actual new species observations and checked study interpretation

steps.what: Record and check actual species-study conclusions and source limitations where required
inputs: actual interpreted species evidence and unanswered questions
actual new species observations and checked study interpretation
outputs: checked final actual species-study record

steps.what: Save checked actual tree-species study record
inputs: checked final actual species-study record
outputs: saved actual species-study conclusions

tasks.design: Configure native species/source links and saved discovery queries in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}. Retain actual scientific reading, classification/ecology interpretation and any actual field study, with complete new-record capture/check before separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Species studies can repeat source discovery and navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native species/source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Local adaptation and resistance conclusions need careful interpretation of real evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The forester recognises when a result from one environment cannot support local planting assumptions.
tasks.altitude: Less species-source navigation; scientific study stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved searches and species-source links can assist discovery; they do not establish tree adaptation or disease resistance.

assumptions: Actual publishers/botanical collections supply source evidence; forester verifies source identity in s1 and retains all substantive reading/assessment in s2. Actual new observations are produced only by retained s3.

Field-study and written-record branches apply only where actual; desk-study-only work removes unused branches and reweights. No mandatory report is invented. Actual dissemination, if required, is a separately exact-final-version gated send with no avoided labour claimed.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Native discovery first; existing saved searches earn zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing checking. Shared site observations counted once.
research_questions: Can native links reduce navigation while preserving full scientific reading?

incremental.description: Maintain actual species/source links and saved queries.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final species-study record and exact study destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 source navigation = 10; minus 0.5 upkeep = 9.5. Half eligible gives 5 minus 0.5 = 4.5. Scientific reading, actual field study, new record capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Foresters retain ecological, field and live-response judgement while actual repeated source navigation and fields may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated administration while preserving scientific reading, field observations and physical implementation.
